niche.habitat: Acid basins, thorium hotspots, volcanic vents.
niche.active: Diurnal; blooms under low-contrast orange light.

body: Plant-like, vascular stems, radial leaves, vacuolar metal crystals, metallothionein proteins, red-shifted pigments.

skill.effect: The creature's crystalline shell strongly deflects heavy metal attacks, leaving it completely unaffected by metal toxins.

chains.weakness: Growth tax: Slow growth rate due to metal sequestration cost.
observe: Slow leaf growth compared to others

journal.en: It drinks poison and turns it into jewels.

plausibility.summary: Say metal-organic complexes and crystalline deposits in vacuoles, keep the growth cost, and use highly tolerant rather than immune.
fixes: Say metal-organic complexes and crystalline deposits in vacuoles, keep the growth cost, and use highly tolerant rather than immune.

analogues.organism: Noccaea or Thlaspi caerulescens for Zn/Cd and Alyssum for Ni; metallothionein and phytochelatin chelation.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

skill.effect: When struck, the creature releases a sharp metallic backlash that harms nearby attackers and coats them in lingering metal toxins.

chains.weakness: Nutrient lock: Cannot release metals easily; poor fertilizer for others.
observe: Soil around roots enriched with metals

journal.en: A garden of needles; nothing eats the sidero-copa but the patient.

plausibility.summary: Flip the observation: available metal is depleted near roots and returned in metal-rich litter. Keep the grazing deterrent.
fixes: Flip the observation: available metal is depleted near roots and returned in metal-rich litter. Keep the grazing deterrent.

analogues.organism: Hyperaccumulator plants such as Alyssum and Noccaea; elemental defence against herbivores in hyperaccumulators.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Metal toxicity in soil and water

skill.effect: Can befrend metal-sensitive creatures; grants antidote effect to allies.

chains.weakness: Metabolic cost: High energy required for chelation; weak in low nutrient areas.

journal.en: It binds the poison in its heart and shares the cure.

plausibility.summary: Frame the Social move as sap that binds dietary metals so animals feeding near it take up less, make the dew a metal-poor chelating solution, and keep the metabolic-cost weakness.
fixes: Frame the Social move as sap that binds dietary metals so animals feeding near it take up less, make the dew a metal-poor chelating solution, and keep the metabolic-cost weakness.

analogues.organism: Plant metallothioneins and phytochelatins; mammalian metallothionein binding Cd/Zn; root exudate chelation.

skill.effect: The organism thrives in dim environments, drawing nourishment strongly from any orange or red light that washes over it.

chains.weakness: Blue blind: Inefficient under blue light; reduced growth in high blue environments.

journal.en: It drinks the orange sun and spits out iron.

plausibility.summary: No change needed; optionally root the trait in F22 as well as F1 and keep the atmospheric speculation flagged.

secrets: Harvest chelation proteins: Sidero-copa sap can be used to craft antidotes.

Nectar is toxic but potent: Can be used as a trap or weapon.
moments: In the acid pools, sidero-copas sway like glass chimes, their leaves heavy with nickel and copper, singing a silent song of survival against the poison soil.
